notes.subject: כנדגלות
notes.rationale: 'Like bannered companies' — traditional 'terrible as an army with banners' vs 'majestic as stars in procession' (Mitchell, followed by BSB)

notes.subject: הנשקפה
notes.rationale: 'The one leaning out / gazing down' — from the window-leanning root שקף; some read 'arising' or 'shining forth'

notes.subject: Mun nin ye
notes.rationale: Rhetorical question addressing the assembly about the woman — a summons to look

notes.subject: ברה
notes.rationale: Echoes 6:9 ברה — 'choice/pure' — linking the verses; the doubled root is lost

translation: Mun nin ye — min bɛ ɲɛda bɔ iya sɔgɔma? Ɲi iya kalo, lejɛ iya tile, min bɛ siran di iya ja-tilenw.
